geminiAnalysis.pageSummary: Shopping demo page presenting a wireless headphone product card on a mobile screen width (390px).

issues.description: The 'Proceed to Checkout' button extends beyond the bounds of the product container card and causes horizontal page overflow.
issues.evidence: The blue 'Proceed to Checkout' button protrudes far to the right beyond the white product card, causing visual clipping and horizontal scroll issues.
issues.likelyCause: Inside the @media (max-width: 600px) query, the CSS explicitly sets '.checkout { width: 650px; }', which exceeds the mobile viewport width of 390px.

recommendations: Set .checkout width to 100% or max-width: 100% in mobile responsive stylesheets to keep elements within viewport bounds.
Avoid using fixed pixel widths greater than standard mobile viewports in mobile media queries.
